stem: What does incidence describe in a scouting record?
choices: The degree of symptom intensity observed on the most severely affected plant in the scouting area
The number or proportion of plants or sites showing the defined problem
The average number of monitoring-device captures during a defined interval, regardless of whether plants show symptoms
The percentage of damaged leaf area on affected plants, averaged across the plants that were already symptomatic
rationale: Incidence describes how many plants or sites show a defined problem, while severity describes the degree of damage or symptoms on affected material.
